summary: Dependency resolved from arbitrary off-registry HTTPS URL
details: package.json declares its sole dependency `daemon-thread-lookup-buffer` as a direct HTTPS URL (https://artifacts.creditslib.com/npm/daemon-thread-lookup-buffer) rather than a registry version range. On `npm install`, npm fetches whatever bytes that host returns and installs them, running any lifecycle scripts contained in that archive, with no version pin and no integrity check. The shipped index.js is a one-line re-export of that dependency, so the external URL is both the install-time and import-time payload surface. The host artifacts.creditslib.com is unrelated to any npm registry or declared publisher infrastructure, is mutable, and controls what executes on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
